response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished full-stack/web software developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang experience, but the resume shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, hardware performance architecture, AI accelerator work, or deep-learning workload optimization — the core requirements of this principal-level hardware performance role. While he has some low-latency systems experience, it is in web microservices rather than hardware-software co-design, making this a fundamental domain mismatch.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience meeting the years-of-experience bar
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work (DLang, async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Strong engineering craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, and community teaching
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, silicon architecture, or hardware performance analysis experience
No AI/deep-learning workload, GPU architecture, or SIMD/MIMD background
Career trajectory is web/full-stack product development, not principal-level hardware/systems architecture

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / DL workload background
General systems programming and performance-oriented experience
